capabilities: Embed the official ChatGPT and Gemini web UIs in the right sidebar
Save conversations as notes in a chosen folder with templated filenames
Convert URLs and similar content when saving conversations
Configure save folder, filename template, UI language, and citation debugging
disambiguation: Not an API chat client; it embeds the official ChatGPT and Gemini web pages and saves the conversation you had there.
extras: Built with Cursor and vibe coding, per the README. Sessions intentionally start logged out; signing in stores state in Electron partitions, not vault notes. The author warns the plugin may break if ChatGPT or Gemini change their sites, and dynamic content like maps may not save correctly. Developer docs live in docs/developer.md.
motivation: The author wants the plugin to help record and organize ideas, and deliberately opens sessions logged out to avoid ChatGPT's echo-chamber effect from loaded conversation history.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture conversations from ChatGPT or Gemini web chats into vault notes without using an API client.

relations.evidence: Open the official ChatGPT / Gemini web UI in Obsidian and save conversations to your vault.
